```sql
    SUM(CASE WHEN pl.ts BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-15' THEN pl.scrap_qty ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN pl.ts BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-15' THEN pl.good_qty + pl.scrap_qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS scrap_rate
FROM 
    production_log pl
JOIN 
    work_orders wo ON pl.wo_id = wo.wo_id
JOIN 
    products p ON wo.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY 
    p.family;
```

question: 지난주 4라인 검사 중 FAIL 판정 비율은?
sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'FAIL') / COUNT(*) AS fail_ratio
FROM 
    inspections 
JOIN 
    work_orders ON inspections.wo_id = work_orders.wo_id
JOIN 
    lines ON work_orders.line_id = lines.line_id
WHERE 
    inspections.ts BETWEEN '2026-09-21' AND '2026-09-27'
    AND lines.line_id = '4'
